about.summary: UNLOCK is an AI innovation competition and grand expo run with iCEP at UiTM Shah Alam. It starts with a 3-week online incubation sprint (7, 14 and 21 Nov) and ends with the Grand Finale Summit on 7 Dec 2026.
objectives: EDIT: Build practical AI skills for students and young professionals
EDIT: Turn ideas into working prototypes

timeline.title: Week 1
timeline.detail: Kickoff, soft launch and Applied AI Literacy.

timeline.title: Week 3
timeline.detail: Prototype and finalist selection. Top 3 Students and Top 3 Professionals pitch live.

timeline.title: Grand Finale Summit
timeline.detail: Dewan Annex / Dewan Seroja, UiTM Shah Alam.

rules: Open to Malaysian university students (undergraduate and postgraduate) and young professionals.
